verdict.rationale: Apify explicitly documents support for building Actors with Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, Scrapy (and its own Crawlee), alongside Python/JS SDKs, base Docker images, and CLI scaffolding tools that support these libraries. missing for 10: independent hands-on tutorials/examples specifically demonstrating Selenium/Scrapy integration beyond the marketing mention, and community corroboration is thin on this specific point.
